principle: use geometry only when it encodes structure, dimension, boundary, projection, bounded domain, topology, or ordered navigation

research-hero.meaning: physical layers mapped into state-space viability geometry

coupled-network-3d.meaning: multilayer topology plus separate viability geometry

research-state.meaning: current stage-2 to stage-3 research transition

project-system.meaning: distinct research systems; shape is navigation only

research-pipeline.meaning: seven ordered stages; polygon side count indexes stage only

shape_semantics.circle: source/origin or neutral point when context labels it
shape_semantics.triangle: endpoint/load or stage marker when context labels it
shape_semantics.quadrilateral: bounded model/domain or affine plane projection
shape_semantics.hexagon: shared interface/hub or bounded research-domain navigation
shape_semantics.ellipse: continuous state/viability region or bounded research-domain navigation
shape_semantics.hyperplane: constraint/critical boundary only when explicitly labeled

non_inference_rule: polygon side count, shape area and shape orientation do not encode scientific importance, evidence strength or empirical validity unless an asset explicitly states otherwise

technology_roles.tikz_overleaf: publication geometry and thesis-ready vector composition
technology_roles.julia: numerical affine geometry, regular polygons and orthogonal projections
technology_roles.python: authoritative deterministic GitHub SVG renderer and runtime validation
technology_roles.react_css: interactive web mirror using SVG and responsive styling
technology_roles.csharp: engineering/CAD geometry integration and reusable projection primitives

scientific_boundary: All README geometry is explanatory unless backed by case-specific calibration or empirical data; geometry does not strengthen evidence class.
